note: Ireland, read on the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment's General Employment Permit page (read 2026-10-30). Either the foreign national or the employer applies; the permit allows employment by that employer in the occupation and places it names (work for the sponsor), and a first-time holder is expected to stay with the first employer 9 months. It is issued for an initial 2 years and renewable for up to three more; after 5 years the holder may apply to the Department of Justice's Immigration Service Delivery for long-term residency. The processing fee is €1,000 for a permit of 6 to 24 months (€500 for 6 months or less). Minimum pay is generally €36,605 a year. The immigration permission's registration fee, long-term residency's terms, EEA and Swiss citizens' free movement and the Common Travel Area, and naturalisation's years were not read (irishimmigration.ie's pages were not reached in this pass).

sources.title: General Employment Permit, Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment (read 2026-10-30)
sources.said: Either the foreign national or the prospective employer can apply for a General Employment Permit ... which permits his or her employment in the State by the employer in the occupation and location/s specified on the permit. ... A General Employment Permit can be issued for an initial period of 2 years and can then be renewed for up to a further three years. After 5 years, the applicant may apply to the Dept Of Justice (Immigration Service Delivery (ISD) for long term residency. ... The processing fee for a new General Employment Permit is ... €1,000 for an employment permit from 6 months up to 24 months duration. ... Minimum annual remuneration - is generally €36,605.
